label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Charles Schwab Withdrawals
items.text: Two big-name recent major champions, including Brooks Koepka, have withdrawn from the Charles Schwab Challenge days before it starts.

items.headline: Bryson Shocked by LIV Funding Cut
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau said he was surprised by Saudi PIF pulling funding from LIV Golf after 2026 but remains optimistic about attracting new investors.

items.headline: LIV Golf Seeks New Investors
items.text: LIV Golf is pitching a 10-event schedule and seeking $250M–$350M in new investment as Bryson DeChambeau pledges to do his best amid uncertainty.
